s01: A bird sits on eleven thousand volts, and nothing happens to it.
s02: It is not insulated. Its feet are bare.
s03: Voltage is not something you touch.
s04: It is a difference between two places.
s05: Both feet are on the same wire, so both feet are in the same place.
s06: Draw it as height, and the wire is flat.
s08: The ground is eleven thousand volts below. The bird is not touching the ground.
s09: Touch a second wire, and a step appears under you.
s10: Now something rolls, and it rolls through you.
s11: That is why big birds die where small birds sit. Wingspan.
s12: You are not safe because you avoided the wire. You are safe because you only touched one thing.
